title: Scientists reidentify Ireland’s “Kerry Cow” bones as bear and wild boar, challenging farming theory
summary_full: Ancient animal bones from Ferriters Cove are now identified as bear and wild boar. This reclassification challenges decades of evidence for early farming in Ireland. Previously thought to be cattle, these remains are now understood differently. Modern scientific techniques revealed the true identity of these ancient specimens. This discovery prompts a reconsideration of Ireland's prehistoric transition to agriculture.
